features.title: Smart suggestions
features.description: Sidekick Pulse delivers personalized recommendations and next steps for your business using market trends and data from your store.

features.title: Custom app generation
features.description: Get Sidekick to build custom apps designed specifically for your business needs.
extra: Create an app that recommends which products I need to reorder.
Create a task tracker for my whole team.
Create an app that checks returns and cancellation eligibility for orders.

features.title: Workflow automations
features.description: Describe the workflow you want to automate, and Sidekick will build it in the Shopify Flow app.

features.title: Custom analytics reports
features.description: Sidekick can generate custom reports and data visualizations directly in the ShopifyQL query editor.

features.title: Segmentation support
features.description: Sidekick can help you build segments or generate them from scratch.

features.title: Generate theme edits
features.description: Tell Sidekick the specific design updates you want and watch it adjust your theme instantly.

features.title: Studio-quality photos
features.description: Prompt Sidekick to change image backgrounds, add or remove elements, and expand canvas size.

features.title: Mobile image editor
features.description: Turn any image into a highly polished product shot with Sidekick using the Shopify mobile app file editor.

features.title: Email editing
features.description: Sidekick can help you edit emails in the Shopify Messaging app email editor.

features.title: Shortcuts for prompts
features.description: Turn your Sidekick prompts into reusable Skills, then share your favorites with the community and discover new ones to try.

features.title: Multi-step task completion
features.description: Partner with Sidekick on more complex tasks now that it can plan, write to-do lists, and take on multiple actions.

features.title: Voice-powered mobile chat
features.description: Speak with Sidekick on the go, right in the Shopify mobile app.

features.title: Wide-mode
features.description: Sidekick goes full screen so you can tackle complex tasks with more room to work.

features.title: App discovery
features.description: Sidekick can help you find, compare, and install apps.

features.title: Target selection
features.description: Sidekick gives contextual answers when clicking on specific areas of the admin.

features.title: Better memory
features.description: Sidekick remembers your chats and unique user preferences.

features.title: Quick company creation
features.description: Sidekick can easily create B2B companies.

features.title: Money management
features.description: Sidekick checks your Shopify Balance and can make transfers with your approval.

features.title: Block generation for all themes
features.description: Sidekick can create custom blocks in any theme from the Shopify Theme Store.

features.description: Schedule theme changes and A/B test with Rollouts, built directly into the admin.

features.title: Shopify SimGym app
features.description: Simulate shopper behavior with AI agents that use data from billions of purchases, and get actionable recommendations before going live.

features.description: Design your store right from the Shopify mobile app by generating a theme, previewing it, and publishing on the go.

features.description: Duplicate collections and exclude products from smart collections using conditional logic.

features.description: Run targeted promotions by creating automatic discounts that target specific customers, such as VIPs.

features.title: Compare-at prices in catalogs

features.description: Find a theme with improved search, more precise industry filters, and templates with less manual setup.

features.title: Customer sign-in with social accounts
features.description: Let customers sign in to your store with Google or Facebook.

features.title: Not your standard hub
features.description: The POS Hub gives you the reliability of wired connections with the processing power of a computer.

features.title: Connections that never drop
features.description: Plug in card readers, printers, and scanners for the strongest, most reliable connection. No pairing required.

features.title: The only hub with processing power
features.description: Built-in software keeps data flowing between your hardware and Shopify POS.

features.title: POS Hub-compatible scanners
features.description: Choose from newly integrated barcode scanners or a range of HID-compatible scanners that work with the POS Hub, iPad, and Android tablets.

features.title: Subscriptions on POS
features.description: Allow customers to sign up for subscriptions in store on your POS using the Shopify Subscriptions app.

features.title: Quick count with POS
features.description: Scan and update inventory directly from your POS to keep stock accurate across channels. Exclusive to POS Pro.

features.title: POS customization in one editor
features.description: Customize the customer display, smart grid, receipts, and lock screen in a single editor.

features.title: Same-day delivery with Uber Direct
features.description: Offer fast local delivery for online orders with live tracking using Uber Direct on POS. Exclusive to Plus. US, Canada, and France only.

features.title: Markets for retail
features.description: Set unique prices and publish products per retail location and online. Exclusive to POS Pro.

features.title: Retail payments in more countries
features.description: Accept in-person payments, including Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android, in Luxembourg, Switzerland, and the Czech Republic.

features.title: QR code payments
features.description: Let customers pay in store with iDeal, Swish, Twint, Mobilepay, and USDC by scanning a QR code and completing checkout on their phone.

features.title: Tap to Pay in more countries
features.description: Let customers Tap to Pay on iPhone in Germany, Ireland, Spain, and New Zealand.

features.title: Cartes Bancaires accepted on POS
features.description: Accept Cartes Bancaires (CB) branded cards from your POS in France.

features.title: Receive transfer shipments in-store
features.description: Accept or reject transfers in store using the Transfers POS extension. Exclusive to POS Pro.

features.title: Customizable return receipts
features.description: Create custom return and exchange receipts with your return policy, logo, and contact information using the Liquid editor.

features.title: Better in-progress return visibility
features.description: Accurately track in-progress returns in your POS and easily cancel unfulfilled items.

features.title: Refund selections on POS
features.description: Choose between original payment, gift card, or store credit on a dedicated refund screen.

features.description: Source and sell other Shopify brands directly from the admin using Shopify Collective, now available in 35 additional countries.

features.title: ACH payments for B2B
features.description: Accept ACH bank payments at checkout with Shopify Payments, and charge saved accounts directly from the admin. Exclusive to Plus. US only.

features.title: Suppliers can discover retailers
features.description: Discover and connect with new retail partners using the Shopify Collective retailer directory.

features.title: Payment requests per fulfillment
features.description: Send a separate payment request for each shipment of a multi-shipment order. Exclusive to Plus.

features.title: Store credit for B2B
features.description: Issue store credit to company locations from their location profile or when refunding orders.

features.title: Pickup in store for B2B
features.description: Let B2B customers select pick up as a delivery option at checkout.

features.title: Dynamic payment terms and deposits
features.description: Use third-party or custom apps powered by Shopify Functions to set dynamic payment terms and deposit requirements. Exclusive to Plus.

features.title: Create rules for order review
features.description: Set dynamic rules to determine which orders need review based on conditions like order values and products, using apps powered by Shopify Functions. Exclusive to Plus.

features.description: Offer quote requests, custom buyer roles, shopping lists, and more using 11 apps compatible with B2B.

features.title: Instant product imports for retailers
features.description: Create public price lists that let retailers import products into their stores without waiting for approval on Shopify Collective.

features.description: Publish imported products to all channels by default on Shopify Collective.

features.description: Sync EDI purchase orders from Crstl and SPS Commerce directly with your admin as draft orders, using pre-built integrations.

features.title: Horizon themes work with B2B

features.title: Continuous funding with the Shopify Capital flex account
features.description: Apply once for ongoing access to funding with Shopify Capital and only pay fees on your outstanding balance. Get replenished funds, subject to approval, as you repay. US only.

features.title: Automatic transfers in Shopify Balance
features.description: Set rules in Shopify Balance to automatically split each payout across accounts, such as expenses, inventory, marketing, and savings. US only.

features.title: Staff cards with spend controls
features.description: Issue Shopify Balance cards to staff and set spend controls. US only.

features.title: Shopify Capital in more European countries
features.description: Access fast funding with adjustable repayment terms in the Netherlands, Spain, and Ireland with Shopify Capital.

features.title: Track international profit margins
features.description: Compare actual and estimated costs by market, including duties, taxes, and shipping adjustments.

features.title: Credits on USDC transactions
features.description: Earn automatic credits on every order paid with USDC, which appear in your order timeline and payouts—paid in fiat or USDC on settlement. US, Mexico, and Hong Kong only.

features.title: Same-day ACH transfers
features.description: Send money from your Shopify Balance account by 1pm ET to have transfers arrive the same business day. US only.

features.title: Unified card dispute
features.description: File and track disputes directly from both Shopify Balance and Shopify Credit transactions lists in a clear, self-serve flow. US only.

features.title: Increased Shopify Credit rewards cap
features.description: Earn 3% cashback on up to $250,000 in eligible purchases on your top spend category annually, and 1% after with Shopify Credit. Earn 1% for all other eligible categories. US only.

features.title: Dynamic credit limits
features.description: Get access to a credit limit that automatically adjusts based on your sales, utilization, and repayments with Shopify Credit. US only.

features.title: Add checks in Shopify Balance
features.description: Add checks directly to your Shopify Balance account using the Shopify mobile app with no fees. US only.

features.title: Real‑time fraud alerts for Shopify cards
features.description: Get SMS fraud alerts for suspicious activity on Shopify Balance and Shopify Credit. US only.

features.title: Build commerce agents
features.description: Bring native shopping into AI conversations with access to the Shopify Catalog API and Checkout MCP, all from the new Dev Dash.

features.title: Shopify Catalog for all
features.description: Search billions of products across Shopify merchants using MCP tools or REST—and soon, select partners can access a direct catalog feed.

features.title: Checkout Kit for web
features.description: Bring a merchant’s checkout to any agentic flow in a browser with a JS library that renders in a pop-up or a new tab—also available in Swift, Android, and React Native.

features.title: Sidekick recommends apps
features.description: Merchants can find and install apps directly in Sidekick, with Built for Shopify apps receiving higher prioritization and clear badges.

features.title: Sidekick app extensions
features.description: Build Sidekick app extensions that let merchants access your app's data and invoke app actions from Sidekick.

features.title: Improved discovery for Built for Shopify apps
features.description: Built for Shopify apps are featured more prominently on the Shopify App Store homepage and in recommendation sections.

features.title: 60-day grace period on Built for Shopify
features.description: Get 60 days to resolve issues across all automated criteria failures while retaining your Built for Shopify badge.

features.title: Improved theme discovery
features.description: Themes are more discoverable with embedded demos and smarter filters.

features.title: Clearer app store requirements
features.description: Get your app review-ready faster with streamlined requirements and clearer documentation.

features.title: Regional admin performance data optimization
features.description: Access regional Web Vitals data to pinpoint slowdowns and optimize your app to deliver faster admin experiences.

features.title: Build with full MCP support
features.description: Code faster with Shopify Dev MCP that validates every API call in real-time, catches errors before you see them, and generates production-ready code.

features.title: Seamless workflows with the Admin Intents API
features.description: Launch admin workflows for creating, editing, and managing Shopify resources with a single line of code.

features.title: Faster bulk operations
features.description: Shopify's bulk operations API now supports all Admin API mutations, accepts 100MB files, and runs up to five concurrent operations.

features.title: Improved metafields and metaobjects
features.description: Metafields and metaobjects render faster on storefronts, support richer query filtering, allow higher entry limits, and more.

features.title: Introducing Tangle
features.description: Build ML and data pipelines collaboratively with an open-source experimentation platform that comes with a powerful visual editor.

features.title: Binary testing in Shopify Functions
features.description: Build tests from real production data and catch breaking changes before they hit production when you migrate from JavaScript to Rust.

features.title: Shopify Dev MCP supports Hydrogen and Shopify API
features.description: Access documentation for Hydrogen and Storefront API in the Dev MCP to build headless Shopify stores with AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

features.title: Liquid support in Shopify Dev MCP
features.description: Validate Liquid code in Shopify Dev MCP to catch errors before deployment.

features.title: Shopify Dev MCP supports POS UI extensions
features.description: Build POS UI extensions faster with AI using Shopify Dev MCP, which pulls right from the POS dev docs, generates valid code, and cuts errors.

features.title: Shopify Functions replace Scripts in 2026
features.description: In June 2026, Shopify Functions will replace Scripts with faster execution and increased parity for a safer migration.

features.title: Dev Assistant supports all of Shopify
features.description: Get access to the full developer platform with the upgraded Dev Assistant, which surfaces targeted documentation and code examples based on what you're trying to build.

features.title: Enhanced security with token expiry
features.description: Use expiring tokens to make your app more secure with OAuth 2.0-compliant token refresh, including programmatic exchange for existing non-expiring tokens.

features.title: Enhanced Dev Console
features.description: Clean up dev previews, uninstall apps, and open the Dev Dashboard directly from the console.

features.title: Multi-environment theme commands
features.description: Execute theme commands in the CLI for multiple environments simultaneously, enabling bulk operations across different stores.

features.title: Polaris unified UI components expand to POS
features.description: Build POS extensions with Polaris web components using a standardized, web-component-based UI system.

features.title: Discount code rejection with Shopify Functions
features.description: Use Shopify Functions to reject discount codes and include an associated custom message displayed at checkout.

features.title: Shop Minis SDK
features.description: Build Shop Minis to create immersive shopping experiences, such as virtual try-on and live shopping, and distribute them directly to Shop app users.

features.title: POS Extensions Storage API
features.description: Reduce API calls and improve performance with persistent, namespaced storage inside the POS app.

features.title: Unlisted product status value
features.description: Build support for the unlisted product status to hide products from search results, collections, and more, while keeping them accessible with a direct URL.

features.title: Combine bundle options with the Admin API
features.description: Use the Admin API to let merchants combine bundle options, such as size and length, into one selection.

features.title: Due on fulfillment terms for pre-orders
features.description: Pre-order apps support customers paying a deposit at checkout and the remaining balance when the order is fulfilled.

features.title: New code editor for themes
features.description: Get Liquid code editing with multi-file search, syntax highlighting, intelligent autocomplete, keyboard shortcuts, side-by-side version diffs, and more.

features.title: Storefront MCP works with Hydrogen stores
features.description: Use Storefront MCP with Hydrogen to build agents that can tailor recommendations, assist with cart building, and hand off to checkout.

features.title: AI discovery for headless stores
features.description: Headless stores are discoverable in AI chats like ChatGPT and Perplexity by automatically being part of the Shopify Catalog.

features.title: Nested cart lines
features.description: Build support for merchants to nest cart lines in cart, checkout, and post-purchase views for product add-ons, such as extended warranties.

features.title: Native wallet buttons before checkout
features.description: Add Shop Pay and Apple Pay wallet buttons on PDP and Cart pages in mobile apps using the Checkout Kit.

features.title: Discount eligibility context field
features.description: Natively support targeted automatic discounts for customer segments, like VIP, without needing Shopify Scripts.

features.title: Payment requirement removed on subscriptions
features.description: Import existing subscribers via API, even if their payment method is missing or expired—just collect or update the details later.

features.title: POS UI extensions for cart line items
features.description: Add contextual actions to an individual POS cart line item, such as dynamic bundles.

features.title: Variant customization on POS
features.description: Sell customizable products in person by adding the same variant to the cart with different configurations, which you can see split into distinct lines.

features.title: More POS UI extension tools
features.description: Build POS UI extensions faster with stable hot reloading, clear in-app build errors, QR deep links, and a new in-app dev console.

features.title: POS UI extensions open native screens
features.description: Open native POS products, orders, customers, draft orders, and staff details in modals that respect staff permissions right in UI extensions.

features.title: Cart Transform Function API on POS
features.description: Use this API to let the POS dynamically expand, merge, or update cart lines for bundles, custom pricing, and rich cart customization.

features.title: Customize subscriptions with POS UI Extensions
features.description: Add and manage subscriptions with detailed line item data using the Cart APIs in POS UI Extensions 2025-10.

features.title: Transfers API
features.description: Model real-world transfers, including those from locations not tracked in Shopify, with the Transfers API.

features.title: Return APIs with payment reference
features.description: Simplify reconciliation for returns through a direct reference to the transaction with the Return API.

features.title: Customer Account API supports third-party apps
features.description: Use Shopify customer authentication to give customers a unified sign-in experience and securely access customer data.

features.title: Store credit refunds in returns API
features.description: Refund to store credit through the return and order cancellation APIs, even when store credit was not the original payment method.

features.title: ShopifyQL API for Shopify Analytics
features.description: Build analytics features faster by querying thousands of combinations of Shopify Analytics metrics and dimensions.

features.title: Returns processing API
features.description: Control when return sales are recorded in Shopify using a new processing mutation.

features.title: Improved onboarding flows with App Bridge
features.description: Use shopify.app.extensions() to check which of your checkout and customer account extensions are active.

features.title: Inventory adjustments reference
features.description: Add referenceDocumentUri to adjustments to show your app in admin history, create audit‑ready trails, and trace changes to its source.

features.title: Payment terms and deposit configurations
features.description: Use the paymentTermsSet operation in Shopify Payment Customization Functions to dynamically change payment terms and deposit requirements. Exclusive to Plus.

features.title: Order review operation in Shopify Functions
features.description: Determine which B2B orders require review based on specific conditions using the orderReviewAdd operation in payment customization. Exclusive to Plus.
